title: The Space calendar Details panel edits in place: title, stage, fields, the plan card, the edit history and the thread

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: redesign the Space calendar with the Calendar system handoff; every Space gets the full calendar and project suite (pass 5 of 9)

detail: Pass 5 of the Space calendar and project suite: the Details panel stops being read only. A date, a to-do and a Plan each take their edits in place: the title is the heading and saves when the person leaves it; the stage is a control; a date has Date, Starts, Length and Notes for the team; a to-do has Due, Owner, Do today, Mark done and Delete; a Plan has its stage and notes. Every edit is a write the calendar already had (saveCalendarEntry, saveCalendarEntryOccurrence, transitionPlanStage, setSpaceTaskDone, moveSpaceTodo, assignPlanTodo, addPlanTodo, pickPencilDate, deleteCalendarEntry, skipPencilDate, postPlanComment, postEntryComment), and a repeating date asks which dates the edit reaches before it writes. Three small doors are new because nothing covered them: renameSpaceTodo, deleteSpaceTodo and editPlanText (a Plan's title or notes without the whole-form save that clears its links), and saveCalendarEntry now writes the entry arm of space_plan_activity for a date on no Plan. The plan context card shows the Spaces (Host, Co-host, Invited, read only), the hold line, Pick this on each held date, and the to-dos grouped Before, Day of and After with how many days before, tickable and addable. Edit history shows three rows and Show all N edits, with the thread under it (Leave a note for both teams), for a Plan or, through the entry arm, for a standalone date. Go live and Go to event are links to the existing production door and event page; Copy to next week, Cancel and Delete are on every date this Space keeps. A person who can only read sees the same panel with no control. Not in this pass: inviting a Space and answering an invite (pass 7), the Published stage segment (an event is published through the production door), an owner on a date (no column), Undo on an inline edit (the handoff has none). Plan: /mnt/project-files/calendar-suite/PLAN.md.
